title: Supabase
description: The open-source Firebase alternative providing a dedicated PostgreSQL database, built-in Authentication, Edge Functions, Realtime subscriptions, and Vector embeddings.
features: Full PostgreSQL database with row-level security (RLS) support
Complete authentication suite with OAuth, magic links, and MFA
Realtime websockets for table change broadcasts
pgvector extension enabled by default for AI embeddings
Automated REST and GraphQL APIs generated straight from SQL schemas
pros: Enterprise-grade relational database with no vendor lock-in
Generous free tier for hobbyists and side projects
Full self-hosting capabilities via Docker Compose
cons: Inactivity pauses on free tier projects after one week
Requires SQL proficiency to craft secure Row-Level Security policies
targetAudience: Full-stack indie hackers, startups, and engineering teams building Postgres-backed web apps.
